name: Interactive Keyboard Models
summary: Eight keyboard variants, each with 36 labeled keycap MeshParts and a touch-response script.
install: Import Keycap/Keyboard into ServerStorage for review, then copy one keyboard Model into Workspace. Preserve its Script, keycap MeshParts and SurfaceGui labels. Scripts respond to character contact and create click sounds/equalizers at runtime.
limits: All eight variants have static front/back previews. Key depression timing, touch response and sound playback remain unverified. Three external sound IDs require access in your experience.
credit: Original supplied hierarchy and embedded scripts are preserved.
verification: Static Studio Edit inspection on isolated clones; no runtime behavior certification. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Original scripts were disabled on static preview clones.
